items.quote: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering
items.claim: Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering
The goat of the sin offering was burnt

items.quote: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron which were left alive
items.claim: Moses was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar

items.quote: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place
items.claim: Eleazar and Ithamar did not eat the sin offering in the holy place
The sin offering is most holy

items.quote: God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD
items.claim: God gave the sin offering to bear the iniquity of the congregation and make atonement

items.quote: Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place
items.claim: The blood of the sin offering was not brought into the holy place

items.quote: ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place, as I commanded
items.claim: Eleazar and Ithamar should have eaten the sin offering in the holy place as commanded
